action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check if client-config.json exists in game-data
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/game-data/world/client-config.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'NOT FOUND'")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())

# If not, create it
if stdout.read().decode().strip() == "NOT FOUND":
    config = '{"supabaseUrl": null, "supabaseAnonKey": null}'
    sftp = client.open_sftp()
    with sftp.file('/opt/areloria/game-data/world/client-config.json', 'w') as f:
        f.write(config)
    sftp.close()
    print("Created config")
else:
    print("Found")

client.close()
EOF
